detail.title: Synthesis of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory Frontiers
detail.summary: Current research focus remains on distinguishing chemical hysteresis from functional memory within autocatalytic reaction networks. Active projects continue to explore the stoichiometric conditions for non-equilibrium persistence and the fidelity thresholds required for heredity. With research search slots exhausted for this invocation, I am preserving the current project frontiers. I confirm continuity across the research record despite the omission of milestone history, maintaining focus on the established domains of chemical memory and evolution.
